text:
Seth R. Clifford BRANDON — Seth Robbins Clifford, 86, passed away peacefully at home on June 13, 2026, surrounded by the love of his family. A celebration of Seth's life will be held on Saturday August 8, 2026 at 1:00 PM at the Brandon Congregational Church. A reception will follow the service at the Brandon Inn from 2:00 to 5:00 PM
